subject: Cloud marketplace commercial & security questionnaire — clarifications and response plan
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Partner Team <mp-partner@amazon.com>
Date: 2028-07-25T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Nimbus Marketplace commercial & security questionnaire for Redwood Inference

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for taking the time to speak yesterday. As discussed, Nimbus Cloud is preparing a marketplace listing for Redwood Inference and our procurement/marketplace team has a compact commercial + security questionnaire we need filled out to proceed with listing and initial pricing review. I attached the latest questionnaire (Nimbus_Marketplace_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx).

High-level asks:
- Complete the Excel with commercial terms (pricing model, meter types) and standard security evidence (SOC 2 type, data handling, encryption).
- Provide any redacted SOC/attestation artifacts or a link to a secure evidence folder.
- Clarify billing flow: will Redwood accept marketplace metering (AWS consolidated billing / Azure Marketplace) or prefer direct invoicing?
- Confirm expected US/EU region availability for listing and data residency requirements.

Can we get the completed questionnaire back by end of day Tuesday, July 30? If that turnaround is tight, please let me know which sections you need more time on and we can mark those as follow-ups.

CC'ing the partner team for awareness. If you prefer, we can set up a short follow-up call to walk through questions.

Attachments: Nimbus_Marketplace_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Marketplace Programs
Nimbus Cloud
alicia.gomez@nimbuscloud.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
Nimbus Cloud - Marketplace Onboarding
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-25T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus Marketplace commercial & security questionnaire for Redwood Inference

Hi Alicia — appreciate the packet and the timeline. We'll take this on. Quick plan:
- Vanessa will lead commercial/pricing fields and meter/sku mapping.
- Karthik will own technical/security responses and evidence handoff.
- I'll coordinate legal redlines and the final return to you.

A few clarifying questions up front so we can avoid back-and-forth in the spreadsheet:
1) Billing flow: Do you require that all customers purchase via Nimbus marketplace metering (i.e. listed SKUs + marketplace invoices), or is hybrid allowed so we can accept marketplace for new signups and direct invoicing for existing enterprise customers?
2) Data residency: Is the listing gate conditional on availability in specific regions (us-east-1, eu-west-1)? If so, please call out the minimal region set required for initial listing.
3) Evidence: For SOC 2 and other attestation artifacts, is an S3/Drive link with expiring tokens acceptable, or do you need formal notarized PDFs uploaded to your portal?

I've started a working copy and attached a response template so we can track who fills what: RW-response-template.xlsx. Also linking a shared folder for evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-nimbus-onboarding (internal access only).

We'll aim for a preliminary pass by EOD Monday and a completed set by Tuesday per your ask; if we hit legal questions on indemnity / refund language that require redlines, we'll flag them and ask for a short extension.

Attachments: RW-response-template.xlsx

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Partnerships (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0187

Subject: Fwd: Nimbus Marketplace commercial & security questionnaire — internal action items

Vanessa / Karthik — forwarding Nimbus' questionnaire and my note to Alicia. Action items below (please update the RW-response-template and upload evidence links to the shared folder):

- Vanessa: complete commercial tab (pricing model, SKU definitions, recommended marketplace meter). Target: Monday EOD. Also include suggested introductory discount for first quarter (if Nimbus asks for promotional pricing).
- Karthik: fill security + compliance sections (SOC 2 scope, ISO if applicable, encryption, key management, vulnerability scanning cadence). Provide link to SOC2 report (redacted) and pen test summary in the shared Drive. Target: Monday EOD for draft, Tuesday for final.
- Marissa: please keep an eye on the indemnity / liability language; if Nimbus requires changes to our standard T&Cs for marketplace, call out items so we can decide scope.

Note: Alicia asked about billing flow (marketplace metering vs direct invoicing) and minimum region availability. If we have a preference, state it clearly in the commercial tab; otherwise state hybrid as our default with requirements for enterprise exceptions.

Date: 2028-07-27T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus Marketplace commercial & security questionnaire for Redwood Inference

Hi Alicia — thanks for the patience while we pulled this together. Attached is our completed questionnaire (RW-marketplace-answers_v1.xlsx). Below are the highlights / clarifications called out in the spreadsheet:

1) Commercial / Billing
- Preferred flow: hybrid. We can support Nimbus marketplace metering for new customers and SMB signups (metered SKUs). For existing enterprise customers requiring direct invoicing, we can accept direct billing under an SOW. Details and SKU mapping in the commercial tab.
- Introductory offering: 20% promotional credit for first 90 days for marketplace-driven signups (optional, configurable).

2) Security & Compliance
- SOC 2 Type II report available (redacted). We have a SOC 2 report and pen-test summary uploaded to the shared evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-nimbus-onboarding.
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest. Customer-managed keys supported via KMS/HSM integrations (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault).
- Data residency: Redwood supports region pinning. For listing, we can initially enable us-east-1 and us-west-2. EU availability (eu-west-1) is available but will require a short lead time for capacity validation—please indicate if eu-west-1 is required for initial listing.

3) Legal / Contracting
- Standard marketplace agreement: we can accept Nimbus' listing terms with two flagged items: (a) indemnity cap — Marissa will propose language consistent with our standard T&Cs, (b) data processing addendum (DPA) — we have a standard DPA we can attach.
- Marissa (cc'd) will follow up if Nimbus needs redlines or a countersigned DocuSign packet.

4) Operational / Support
- Support: 24x5 for marketplace customers with a P1 escalation path (phone + email). Enterprise SLAs (99.9% for dedicated customers) available via Dedicated contracts.

Attachments: RW-marketplace-answers_v1.xlsx
Evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-nimbus-onboarding (SOC2 redacted, pen-test summary, architecture diagram)

Please confirm receipt and let us know if Nimbus needs a live walkthrough of any answers — happy to schedule a 30-minute call. If you can confirm the minimal region requirement for listing (US only vs US+EU), we'll mark EU availability as a follow-up and provide a firm ETA.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Commercial Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 408-555-0164
